title: metric-definition
description: The declared shape of a metric definition. A shape block in a definition file declares these fields; a proposal against a definition is checkable field-wise against this schema.

population.description: Who is counted, including edge-case treatment (e.g. paused members)

filter.description: The qualifying condition and its window (e.g. 'qualifying-act within 90d')

denominator.description: Required when unit is 'rate' — a rate without a denominator convicts itself

owner.description: The actor who owns this definition
